# Data-Driven Decisions with Ease

Our analytic tools offer all you need to understand of your desired audiences. Use the Data Analysis Tool (DAT) for thousands of variables and filters (MTM 18+, Juniors, Newcomers), the Trending Tool for identifying key trends, and the Forecasting Tool for reliable, accurate projections.

[Request a Demo](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/request-demo/)

![MTM analytic tool dashboard](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/analytic-tools/Analytic-tool.webp)

## Data Analysis Tool

MTM 18+ MTM Junior MTM Newcomers

The Data Analysis Tool (DAT) offers subscribers easy access to MTM 18+, Junior and Newcomers data. Select data, filter results and get answers to burning questions.

#### Explore Tool Features

[](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/analytic-tools/dat/tools-query.mp4)

QUERY BUILDING

Easily create a custom query

Select query parameters, drag variables from the master list into output rows and columns. What you arrange is exactly what you get. No SQL or python, no analyst handoff, no waiting. Go from brief to cross-tab in minutes.

[](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/analytic-tools/dat/tools-select-variables.mp4)

VARIABLES

Large, robust data sets at your fingertips

Thousands of variables covering demographics, device ownership, media habits, platform usage — all in a single searchable list by categories. When a client asks an unexpected question mid-meeting, you have the variables to answer it on the spot.

[](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/analytic-tools/dat/tools-quick-filters.mp4)

FILTERS

Refine your query with Quick or Additional Filters

Narrow your results by age gender or region with Quick Filters or apply any variables in the tool as filter using Additional Filters.

[](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/analytic-tools/dat/tools-drag-drop.mp4)

CUSTOM TABLES

Our data, your way

Easily adjust or refine your query with drag and drop functionality. No headaches, just a new table with new results in seconds.

[](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/analytic-tools/dat/tools-export.mp4)

OUTPUT FORMATS

Results in multiple formats

Choose your chart type: bar, pie, line; then export to Excel, PDF, Word, or image. No reformatting required. Use the YourData features (hyperlink to bottom of page) for even more display options.

## Trending Tool

MTM 18+ MTM Junior

The Trending tool offeres 20+ years of data all in one place. Find all the trends about past and present media technology.

![Trending Tool preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/analytic-tools/trending-tool.webp)

What You See

Which technologies are rising or losing ground

Track adoption curves across media types. Know which platforms are winning the streaming wars when it comes to your target audiences.

What You Track

Where your audiences are heading towards

Multiple years of seasonal updates means you can show momentum, not just a snapshot. Bring a clear trajectory and focus to your next client meeting.

What You Compare

Exhaustive filter options

See results by age, gender, region, education, income, household composition community size and more.

![Forecasting Tool preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/analytic-tools/forecasting-tool.webp)

## Forecasting Tool

MTM 18+

The Forecasting Tool helps project future technology adoption and model scenarios. Know where things are headed in the next 1 to 5 years.

What You Project

Where technology adoption is heading and when

Multi-year projections built on MTM's nationally representative dataset and refined by industry experts. Not a guess — a model grounded in years of observed behaviour and perfected by talented minds.

What You Model

Key technologies like podcasts, AI tool usage, paid TV subscriptions and more

Explore a variety of different media and technology within a few clicks.

What You Compare

National, Anglophone and Francophone markets

Find out how these markets allign or don't with an eye toward the future.

## YourData

YourData is your personalized hub to save, organize, and export data queries across MTM tools. Build once, reuse, refine and easily export.

Smart Storage

Save all your DAT, Trending, and Forecasting queries in one place.

Custom Visualization

Modify colours, chart labels, legends and more, no extra software required.

Detailed Options

Create pie charts, bar charts or tables and have full control over labelling.

Flexible Exporting

Download report or presentation ready data, built your way.
